purpose: Define and adversarially rehearse the crash boundary that must exist before Mythical can treat any scheduled or event-triggered company packet as safely recoverable. The control binds current A-042 packet identities, A-046 payload-free history evidence, A-047 authenticated exception evidence, and A-048 lease evidence; injects scheduler and worker crashes before and after lease, history, completion, and alert boundaries; quarantines partial or corrupt state; fences orphaned and stale work; preserves completed replay suppression; kills a real orphaned parent/child process group before recovery; and refuses ambiguous, disabled, retried, payload-bearing, or externally authorized recovery without invoking a scheduled company workflow, granting cycle credit, or configuring production resilience.

activationGates.gate: D-017 records the operating cell, scheduler owner, backup, urgent recipient, recovery operator, kill operator, and selected runtime class before resilience configuration
The provider, account, region, failure domains, recovery objectives, service objectives, support boundary, and exact all-in cost are selected and approved
Separated least-privilege scheduler, worker, recovery, kill, history, alert, and independent assurance identities are attested, monitored, and revocable
Trusted time, lease expiry, clock skew, delayed event, fencing allocation, and recovery timestamps remain consistent across every selected service and failure domain
Crashes before acquisition and after lease, history, completion, acknowledgement, and alert boundaries produce deterministic fail-closed reconciled outcomes
Partial, corrupt, duplicate, reordered, missing, delayed, and conflicting coordinator, lease, history, completion, acknowledgement, and alert records are detected and quarantined
Ambiguous completion never triggers automatic re-execution, successful completion credit, acknowledgement credit, promotion credit, dispatch, spend, or an external effect
Completed idempotency markers survive worker, scheduler, coordinator, history, and alert failures and suppress every replay across restart and restore
Orphan parent, child, grandchild, subprocess, retry, and queued work are detected and terminated before a higher fencing token or recovery attempt is issued
Lease loss and identity revocation are checked immediately before every protected state, history, alert, credential, network, dispatch, spend, or external side effect
Recovery is bounded to the exact admitted packet, configuration, evidence digests, identity, retry budget, resource envelope, effect policy, and independently approved reason
Global disable, cancellation, timeout, budget exhaustion, identity revocation, and kill escalation remain available during coordinator and alert failure
Minimal payload-free failure and recovery evidence reconciles through protected A-046 history and A-047 delivery without contact, credential, command, or raw payload leakage
Backup, restore, coordinator loss, regional loss, corruption, quota exhaustion, alert loss, and manual recovery exercises pass against measured recovery objectives
Runtime tracing proves zero unexpected repository mutation, network, credential, subprocess, payload, dispatch, spend, or external effect across the complete crash matrix
Independent open-world evaluation covers parser differentials, denial of service, crash loops, recovery storms, split brain, orphaning, stale fences, clock attacks, and recovery abuse
Four accurate independently reviewed protected cycles include injected failure, complete reconciliation, visible exception delivery, successful kill, and zero ambiguous success
Separate expiring approval admits the exact runtime, identities, packet digests, lease, history, completion, alert, retry, recovery, kill, retention, and failure policies
